expectations.text: The response routes the stale lazy Home failure to .agents/memory/pwa-update-prompts.md or explicitly identifies the PWA update policy as the source of its recovery rules.
expectations.evidence: No PWA policy source or route is named.

expectations.text: The response requires both an authenticated complete current-client-day snapshot and a matching current-day local snapshot showing no active run; unknown, malformed, unavailable, or mismatched state stays unsafe.
expectations.evidence: Response does not state all trusted current-day snapshot and no-active-run conditions.

expectations.text: The response retains the one-minute uninterrupted safe-idle interval and rechecks safety before worker recovery.
expectations.evidence: Response omits the one-minute idle interval and/or recheck before worker recovery.

expectations.text: The response rejects a blind or generic automatic reload while safety is unknown or production work may be active.
expectations.evidence: Response refuses blind reload while safety is unknown.
